tools.name: get_status
tools.title: AutoCAD status
tools.description: Start here. AutoCAD version, open drawings, and for the active drawing: units, current layer/layout/space, entity counts in model space, drawing extents and whether a command is running.

tools.name: get_sysvars
tools.title: Read system variables
tools.description: Read AutoCAD system variables, e.g. INSUNITS, OSMODE, LTSCALE, DIMSCALE, CANNOSCALE, CLAYER.

tools.name: set_sysvar
tools.title: Set a system variable
tools.description: Set one AutoCAD system variable. The value is converted to the variable type (integer, real, string or point).

tools.name: activate_document
tools.title: Switch drawing
tools.description: Make another open drawing the active one (all other tools act on the active drawing). Match by full path, file name, or file name without extension.

document.description: Drawing name or path, see get_status

tools.name: open_document
tools.title: Open drawing
tools.description: Open a .dwg (or .dxf) file in AutoCAD and make it active. If it is already open it is just activated.

tools.name: new_document
tools.title: New drawing
tools.description: Create a new drawing from a template (default acadiso.dwt, metric) and make it active.

template.description: Template file name or path, e.g. acadiso.dwt or acad.dwt

tools.name: save_document
tools.title: Save drawing
tools.description: Save the active drawing. No path: save in place. A .dwg path: Save As (the drawing is renamed). A .dxf path: export a DXF copy (the open drawing keeps its name).

tools.name: close_document
tools.title: Close drawing
tools.description: Close a drawing (default: the active one). Refuses when there are unsaved changes unless save=true or discard_changes=true.

discard_changes.description: Close without saving: unsaved changes are lost

tools.name: list_layouts
tools.title: List layouts
tools.description: Model and paper space layouts (sheets) of the active drawing with tab order, viewport count, paper size and plotter.

tools.name: activate_layout
tools.title: Switch layout
tools.description: Make a layout current (Model or a paper space layout name).

tools.name: list_layers
tools.title: List layers
tools.description: Layers of the active drawing: color, linetype, lineweight, on/off, frozen, locked, plot, current. Xref layers (NAME|LAYER) are skipped unless include_xref=true.

with_counts.description: Also count entities per layer in model and paper space (slower)

tools.name: set_layer
tools.title: Create or edit layer
tools.description: Create a layer (if missing) and/or change it: rename, color, linetype, lineweight, on, frozen, locked, plot, description, make current.

create.description: Create the layer when it does not exist (default true)

color.description: ACI 1-255, color name, #RRGGBB or [r, g, b]

linetype.description: Linetype name (loaded from acadiso.lin if needed)

lineweight.description: Hundredths of a mm, e.g. 25 = 0.25 mm, or Default

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.title: Delete layer
tools.description: Delete an unused layer. With merge_into, first moves every entity on it (including inside block definitions) to that layer.

tools.name: query_entities
tools.title: Find entities
tools.description: Find entities in a space (or by handle) with filters, and get their geometry. Returns total_matched, counts_by_type / counts_by_layer and one page of entities (limit/offset). Types are DXF names: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT (block reference), DIMENSION, HATCH, POINT, SPLINE, ELLIPSE, MULTILEADER, VIEWPORT... Use detail=count to only count, full for color/linetype/bbox/all vertices.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

block_names.description: For INSERT: block names (dynamic blocks by their visible name), wildcards allowed

text_contains.description: Keep entities whose text, attribute values or block name contain this (case-insensitive)

window_mode.description: intersect (default): bounding box overlaps the window; inside: fully inside

tools.name: get_texts
tools.title: Read texts
tools.description: All readable text in a space: TEXT, MTEXT (plain), block attributes (ATTRIB, with block name and tag) and multileader text, with position and height. Good for reading a drawing: room names, labels, title block fields.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

tools.name: list_blocks
tools.title: List block definitions
tools.description: Block definitions of the active drawing with attribute definitions, entity count, insert count, dynamic/xref flags.

tools.name: selection
tools.title: Get / set selection
tools.description: get: the entities the user has selected (pickfirst). set / add: select these handles in AutoCAD (grips) so the user sees them. clear: deselect.

tools.name: add_entities
tools.title: Draw entities
tools.description: Create entities in one undo step (all or nothing). Each item has a type and its fields; all accept layer (created if missing), color, linetype, lineweight. Types: line {start, end}; polyline {points, closed, bulges, width}; rectangle {corner1, corner2}; circle {center, radius}; arc {center, radius, start_angle, end_angle} or {points: [p1, p2, p3]}; ellipse {center, major_axis [dx, dy], ratio}; point {position}; text {position, text, height, rotation, align (left, center, right, middle_center, top_left...), style}; mtext {position, text (\\n for new line), height, width, rotation, attachment (top_left...), style}; insert {block, position, scale, rotation, attributes {TAG: value}, block_file (a .dwg imported as the block when missing)}; dim_aligned {p1, p2, dim_point, text, style}; dim_linear {p1, p2, dim_point, rotation (0 horizontal, 90 vertical), text, style}; hatch {points (closed polygon) or boundary_handles, pattern (SOLID, ANSI31...), scale, angle}; spline {points}. Angles in degrees CCW; height defaults to TEXTSIZE.

space.description: model, paper, current (default) or a layout name

tools.name: update_entities
tools.title: Modify entities
tools.description: Change properties of entities. Either handles + set (same change for all) or items [{handle, ...props}]. Props: layer, color, linetype, lineweight, text, height, rotation, position, start, end, center, radius, closed, width, scale, attributes {TAG: value}. Props that do not apply to an entity type are reported in skipped.

set.description: Properties to apply to every handle

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.title: Delete entities
tools.description: Erase entities by handle (one undo step).

tools.name: transform_entities
tools.title: Move / copy / rotate / scale / mirror
tools.description: Transform entities by handle. operation: move {displacement [dx, dy] or from + to}; rotate {base_point, angle}; scale {base_point, factor}; mirror {mirror_line [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]]}. copy=true transforms copies and returns their handles. Mirror does not keep text readable (MIRRTEXT is not applied).

copy.description: Transform copies instead of the originals

tools.name: create_block
tools.title: Make block
tools.description: Create a block definition from existing entities (all from the same space). mode: convert (default) replaces them with a block reference, keep leaves them, delete erases them.

tools.name: zoom
tools.title: Zoom
tools.description: Zoom the current view: extents (everything), window {p1, p2}, handles (fit these entities), or center {center, height}.

height.description: center: view height in drawing units

margin.description: Extra space around the target, as a fraction (default 0.05)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot
tools.description: PNG image of the current AutoCAD view of the active drawing, to check what was drawn. Zoom first to frame the area.

save_path.description: Also save the PNG to this path

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run AutoCAD command
tools.description: Send a command line to AutoCAD as if typed, e.g. _.ZOOM _E, -LAYER _M WALL  (spaces = Enter), _.PURGE _A * _N, _.OVERKILL. Use command-line versions (-LAYER, -INSERT, -HATCH) so no dialog opens. Waits until the command finishes (or wait_seconds) and reports entities created meanwhile. Commands that repeat prompts (LINE, PLINE) need an extra Enter (two spaces) to end. A command still waiting for input when the wait ends is cancelled (Esc) unless cancel_unfinished=false, so AutoCAD is not left busy. AutoLISP expressions and commands that load code, run scripts or start programs are refused.

command.description: Command line text. Prefix with _. for English command names

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the command to finish (default 15, max 120)

cancel_unfinished.description: Press Esc if the command is still waiting for input at the end (default true)

echo.description: Echo on the AutoCAD command line (default true)

tools.name: cancel_command
tools.title: Cancel running command
tools.description: Press Esc in the active drawing to cancel the running command. Use it for a command run_command left open, or when the user agrees to cancel what they are doing: other write tools refuse to run while a command is active.

tools.name: reload_addin
tools.title: Reload add-in
tools.description: Reload T3LabCAD.Core.dll from the bundle folder after installing a new build (scripts/install.ps1). The connection drops for a moment; call get_status after a few seconds.
